method: Grate the paneer using a grater or mash it with your hands.
Finely chop the onions, ginger, and green chilies.
Heat ghee or oil in a pan. Add the chopped onions and sauté until they turn translucent.
Add the green chilies and ginger, and sauté for a minute.
Add the grated paneer, turmeric powder, and salt. Mix well.
Cook on low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the grated coconut and garam masala. Give it a good mix.
Finally, add the lemon juice and chopped coriander leaves.
Garnish with curry leaves and serve hot with rotis or bread.
